sites.evidence: AppleMobileFileIntegrity's GOT slot for PAGE_SHIFT_CONST. Its only reader is the CoreEntitlements DER iterator's stack check (sp & ((1 << *slot) - 1) < 0x80 returns error 2), which assumes the stack base is aligned to 1 << shift, as on 16 KiB-page Apple kernels where the two lower guard pages are 32 KiB. On the native 4 KiB kernel the stack starts 8 KiB into a 32 KiB-aligned allocation, so the page shift (and 14) give false out-of-stack errors at fixed call depths (OSEntitlements copyDictionary failed with 14 on the exec path). Bound to unixnu_kernel_stack_shift, the allocation alignment shift (15), for which sp & mask stays at least 8 KiB inside any stack. The other ~70 components keep PAGE_SHIFT_CONST for page arithmetic.
